reader.requirement: At 85 an executed IF must: on true run statement-1 (imperative, or conditional optionally preceded by imperative) and then go to the end of the IF, or on true with NEXT SENTENCE go to the next executable sentence; on false run statement-2 and go to the end of the IF, go to the end of the IF when there is no ELSE, or go to the next executable sentence for ELSE NEXT SENTENCE; explicit transfers inside an arm (GO TO, a conditional phrase's GO TO) follow their own rules.

reader.notes: EmitIf lowers to a C# if/else over the bound arms; NEXT SENTENCE lowers to a jump to the sentence-end label EmitParagraphBody plants, or the paragraph fall-through in the last sentence, so all five arms behave per GR2 at 85. Sibling: the SR3 under-rejection (NEXT SENTENCE with END-IF accepted at 85) is kb/Work PB5798, open, and does not affect GR2's run-time arms.

refuter.evidence: if3.cob at 85 (runs/if3-003): true NEXT SENTENCE skips the rest of the sentence including a PERFORM (A3); GO TO ... DEPENDING with an out-of-range value in statement-1 falls through to the next statement then the end of the IF (C1 C2, VI.6.15.4 GR3); NEXT SENTENCE as the last sentence of PERFORM R1 THRU R2 returns (E1 E3); ELSE NEXT SENTENCE as the last sentence of a performed SECTION returns without falling into the next section (F1 F3); THEN and nested IF in ELSE. if4.cob (runs/if4-001): imperative followed by a conditional ADD with NOT ON SIZE ERROR as statement-1, the outer ELSE matched to the IF (A1 A2 2 A3); conditional statement-2 (B1 B2 2 B3); ALTERed GO TO in statement-1 goes to the altered target (C1); nested IF/ELSE pairing (D1 D2); compound condition with ELSE NEXT SENTENCE (E1 E2). An IF with NEXT SENTENCE inside inline PERFORM/EVALUATE WHEN/SEARCH WHEN is refused unless END-IF closes it (COBOL2796), which is SR3's territory (PB5798), not GR2. cite: OK  §1985:VI.6.16.4 GR2  (6.16.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2; OK  §1985:VI.6.15.4 GR3.
